purpose: Freeze how qualified privileged evidence may define teacher state, how RNA-recoverable state may supervise the student, and how privileged-only state is kept private.

student_inference_inputs: query/address information already authorized by the RNA architecture
lawful observation-operator descriptors if prospectively qualified

lane_roles.stage4_lane: Establish whether real frozen RNA×ATAC correspondence evidence is interpretable under prospective statistics and custody. It produces evidence objects, not model inputs.
lane_roles.architecture_lane: Establish software semantics for shared/private state, missing privileged evidence, observation operators, anti-collapse, and evidence/measurement uncertainty. Synthetic passes do not create biological authority.
lane_roles.integration_boundary: Only independently qualified privileged evidence may enter teacher-state construction, and only the RNA-recoverable projection of that teacher state may supervise the RNA student.

stage4_rna_atac.eligibility_rule: May enter teacher-state construction only if Stage-4 execution is separately authorized, executed once under the frozen contract, and its anti-false-green/interpretability gates permit biological interpretation.
stage4_rna_atac.if_interpretable_null: May contribute null/uncertainty information but may not be promoted as positive regulatory signal.
stage4_rna_atac.if_uninterpretable: Excluded from teacher regulatory signal; preserve failure receipt.

scenic_plus.eligibility_rule: Requires an explicit current-source/provenance contract and leakage audit before teacher-state use.

perturbation_etl.eligibility_rule: May constrain or validate biological interpretation only under an explicit lineage/split contract; no protected outcome may select representation.

other_privileged_modalities.eligibility_rule: Each source requires its own custody, leakage, population and observation-operator qualification.

teacher_state_construction.source_inclusion_rule: prospective source registry only; no choosing modalities because their observed downstream result is favorable
teacher_state_construction.source_normalization_rule: source-specific observation operators may correct measurement realization but may not encode arbitrary dataset/donor identity as biological state
teacher_state_construction.missing_privileged_evidence: represented explicitly as unavailable/masked with uncertainty; never silently zero-filled as measured biology
teacher_state_construction.rotation_rule: state authority attaches to subspaces/geometry where coordinates are non-identifiable; arbitrary latent rotations are not scientific changes

recoverability_protocol.objective: Determine which components/subspaces of the richer teacher regulatory state are predictably recoverable from lawful RNA evidence.
recoverability_protocol.unit_of_split: donor first; source/study/technology held out where feasible and prospectively declared
recoverability_protocol.student_inputs: RNA-side lawful evidence only; no privileged values, masks that reveal protected outcomes, or future teacher values
recoverability_protocol.target_candidates: teacher regulatory subspaces constructed without recoverability TEST
primary_recoverability_evidence: increment over generic-cell/RNA baseline that lacks the candidate privileged target
evidence-response and measurement-response diagnostics kept distinct
recoverability_protocol.coordinate_metrics_role: supporting only when basis stability has independently justified coordinate interpretation
recoverability_protocol.selection_rule: A component/subspace enters Z_reg_shared only when its donor-held-out recoverability has positive validation evidence above lawful baselines and the result is not explained by technical/source shortcuts. No minimum real biological effect size is invented prospectively without scale authority.
recoverability_protocol.private_rule: Anything not qualified as recoverable remains Z_reg_private; failure to recover is not converted to a zero target.
recoverability_protocol.uncertainty_rule: When privileged evidence is absent or a state component is not identifiable from RNA, student uncertainty must reflect that limitation rather than confident imputation.
recoverability_protocol.test_rule: TEST is opened once only after target construction, recoverability algorithm, baselines, metrics, selection rule and reporting format are frozen; TEST does not tune the projection.

training_authorization_gates: Stage-4 outcome, if used, has separately passed execution and interpretation authority
all privileged source lineages used by teacher are enumerated and frozen
Z_reg_shared and Z_reg_private are explicitly versioned
student input schema contains no privileged modalities
anti-collapse and shortcut diagnostics are active
recoverability TEST remains sealed until the prospective test authorization step
forbidden_shortcuts: predicting privileged modality values and calling that biological state without a state contract
forcing Z_reg_private into the RNA student loss
choosing the privileged source or latent dimension after seeing recoverability TEST
using dataset ID, donor ID or protected outcome as a biological feature
zero-filling unavailable privileged state and treating zero as measured
promoting synthetic fixture thresholds to production thresholds
using Stage-4 significance alone as model-training authority
